    "import arrow; import dateutil.tz as tz; import datetime\n"
    "a = arrow.Arrow.now()\n"

    "exp = datetime.datetime.now().replace(tzinfo=tz.tzlocal())\n"
    "print('Expected tzinfo:', type(exp.tzinfo), exp.tzinfo)\n"
    "print('Equal?', a._datetime.tzinfo == exp.tzinfo)"],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
print(result.stdout)
